meta_title: T Bye Landscape Gardener | Garden Design Leeds
meta_description: T Bye Landscape Gardener specialises in garden design, construction, and planting across Leeds. Expert landscaping for your outdoor space. Call today.
hero_eyebrow: Expert Garden Design & Build — Local to Leeds
hero_subhead: Professional landscape design and construction that turns your Leeds garden vision into reality, from concept to planting.
services_heading: Complete Garden Design & Landscaping Services Across Leeds
services_subhead: From initial design through to planting and construction, we handle every aspect of your garden transformation.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke garden layouts tailored to your space and lifestyle. We create detailed plans that balance aesthetics, functionality, and budget before any work begins.

services.title: Garden Construction
services.desc: Professional build work including patios, raised beds, decking, and water features. We use quality materials and expert craftsmanship to create lasting outdoor structures.

services.title: Plant Selection & Planting
services.desc: Expert guidance on choosing the right shrubs, trees, and perennials for your soil and climate. We source quality plants and ensure proper planting for thriving gardens.

services.title: Landscape Transformation
services.desc: Complete garden overhauls that maximise your outdoor space. Ideal for tired gardens needing fresh layouts, improved drainage, or updated landscaping features.

services.title: Hardscaping & Paving
services.desc: Premium patio installation, pathways, and garden edging using natural stone or quality pavers. Built to withstand Yorkshire weather and enhance garden usability.

services.title: Garden Maintenance Planning
services.desc: Design gardens that are easy to maintain and look stunning year-round. We recommend low-maintenance plant combinations and seasonal care advice for long-term success.

about_pullquote: Every garden tells a story—I help mine tell one you'll love living in.
about_para_1: T Bye Landscape Gardening has been transforming gardens across Leeds for nearly two decades. Starting with a passion for thoughtful garden design and quality craftsmanship, we've built a reputation for delivering gardens that genuinely enhance the way people use their outdoor space. Each project begins with listening—we take time to understand your vision, your soil, and your lifestyle before a single spade touches the ground.
about_para_2: Customers return to us because we treat every garden as unique. Unlike one-size-fits-all approaches, we combine creative design with horticultural knowledge and honest advice about what will and won't work in your Leeds garden. Whether you're starting from scratch or refreshing a tired space, you'll work with someone who cares as much about the result as you do.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Our Garden Work

reviews.text: T came round, listened to what we wanted, and delivered a garden we actually use now. The design feels natural and the planting is thriving. Best money we've spent on the house. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Had a complete overgrow mess. T sorted the whole thing—designed it, built the paths and beds, sourced proper plants that suit our shady spot. The transformation is incredible. Really professional bloke.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: We got three quotes. T was honest about what would work and what wouldn't. Didn't try to upsell us. Garden looks brilliant, and everything's growing well. Can't fault the service.
reviews.author: Alison M.
